title: Introducing the Stateful Runtime Environment for Agents in Amazon Bedrock
summary: Stateful Runtime for Agents in Amazon Bedrock brings persistent orchestration, memory, and secure execution to multi-step AI workflows powered by OpenAI.
body: Stateful Runtime for Agents in Amazon Bedrock brings persistent orchestration, memory, and secure execution to multi-step AI workflows powered by OpenAI.
summaryZh: Amazon Bedrock推出状态化运行时环境（Stateful Runtime Environment），旨在为AI Agent提供持久化编排、记忆存储及安全执行能力。该功能支持多步骤AI工作流，能够有效提升基于OpenAI模型构建的智能体在复杂任务处理中的稳定性和上下文保持能力。

aiReview.reasonZh: Amazon Bedrock引入状态化运行时，显著提升了AI Agent在复杂工作流中的持久化与执行能力。

glossary.explanationZh: 指能够保存任务执行状态和上下文的运行环境。
指对多个AI任务或步骤进行协调与调度。
指需要多个连续步骤完成的复杂AI任务流程。
